The couch frame is totally askew which you can see in the photos. I wish there would have had more quality control in the construction, it could have been an incredible set. neg_samples.title: Don't Let Influencers Fool You
neg_samples.text: Buyer Beware! This set is promoted by every influencer on Instagram and Tiktok. Let me be the one to tell you this set is JUNK! We purchased the River Oaks sofa/table set along with the chairs in May. Every morning all the cushions are damp. Product description says repels water and stains and that it is 3M Scotchguarded. I cover our set when it's not in use which is about 90% of the time. We typically sit out and have coffee in the morning and maybe sit outside in the evening if the weather is bareable. We kept noticing light stains on some of the tops of the back cushions. I kept saying to my husband it looks like mold, but how could it be, it's brand new! Well today I lifted a cushion and sure enough on the bottom was a huge patch of mold. I'm utterly disappointed in the quality of this set. This is an outdoor set! Why on earth would an outdoor set not be water resistant. When I unzipped the cushion the material inside is exactly like my indoor furniture. It is a sponge foam covered in white cheap cover. I've honestly never been so disappointed in a product! I am working with the manufacturer now as I believe this is a quality issue. My neighbors have this same set and bought it in 2020 and they do not have this issue. I've included just a few photos for reference.

neg_samples.title: DO NOT BUY
neg_samples.text: Warning!! Do not order this or any other large item from Walmart. It's been a nightmare trying to return the items which were received damaged. We ordered the sofa, nesting tables and the 2 swivel chairs which all came as a set. The frame of one chair was bent so badly we could barely put it together and once we did it was unsafe to sit in. Also one of the sofa cushions had a giant slash in it like it had been cut with a knife (the box was not damaged and I did not use anything sharp to open the box). I did not want to return them and asked for replacements but customer service kept telling me different stories. One person said I could get a replacement chair and a cushion, the next person said I couldn't then returned everything when I didn't want to return them. Then the chairs sold out and they said they would send me a replacement sofa but could not guaranteed the chairs would ever be back in stock so I agreed to return the entire set and the customer service person I was talking to said they had processed the return. Then out of the blue they tried to ship me another sofa which I had to cancel myself through the shipping company. After a month of this headache I returned everything via the shipping method and company Walmart chose. Now Walmart is saying I only returned the sofa set and refuses to refund me for the chairs which were returned along with the sofa. I literally helped the driver load all of the items into his truck! I have even spoken with the shipping company and they assured me they received all of the pieces, including the chairs, and turned them over to Walmart the following day. Walmart is still refusing to refund my money and is no longer answering my emails to customer service. I know this is a popular item with Instagram influencers and my experience has proved that Walmart doesn't care about its normal customers only those that advertise for them.

Once received a few days later, we opened the package to find the arm to be the wrong color. I called customer service again, went through the whole spiel with a new rep who looked up the item (which apparently they do not have in the system, only a conversation set that includes the glider chairs which is NOT what we have) and once confirmed which part we needed, she sent an email for shipping. Received that part (3 days later) to find that THE WRONG ARM TO THE WRONG CHAIR was sent. So now here I am on phone with customer service for the THIRD time trying to get the correct part for the defective piece. When I asked if we could just save time and get a new chair, I was told that the customer service company is not part of the vendor, only associated, and they could not send the whole item. So now we wait a few more days to see if we actually get the piece so we can complete the chair. Save yourself the headache and spend your money elsewhere.

neg_samples.text: I purchased the 2 pack of these patio chairs ( 4 total chairs) for $883.56. When I purchased them online, delivery for that day was available so we chose that option. The delivery was pushed back a day and then our order was out for delivery the next day. When the delivery driver got to our house, it was only 2 chairs. They were not in box. They were assembled, we received no chair covers like it says in description and was missing half of our order. The chairs we received had bird crap on them and said came from a "Warehouse" and not a Walmart Store. So we had to call Walmart to try and figure out or order. The only solution they could give me was to refund my money for the chairs we didn't receive in up to 10 business days and then we could repurchase the chairs. I have called twice, and our account isn't updated with this information and did not receive an email confirming this. I called again, to get an email saying we would be issued a rerund and was told it would take up to 48 hours. I think that is not an acceptable timeframe for Walmarts mistake. I wanted an email to protect myself and they will not send it and was told it could take up to 48 hours to get that email. I was told our account reflects that on their end, but not on our end. Our account says "Delivered" and I was asked to sign saying we received so they could start a refund for missing product. They did not offer to resend our other chairs. We could not go pick them up from a local store. We are the ones inconvenienced in this entire situation and we are not sure if we going to keep the chairs because this experience is frustrating. For the amount of money we paid, we expected chairs in a box BRAND NEW. The tags show "clearance" and came assembled. Just not happy at all with this order. I do think this could have been handled better. Looking back, we should have declined the order when it got delivered the way it did. The chairs itself are good looking and comfortable but not worth the hassle we went through to get them.
